The main takeaway from our work is that
digital predistortion can be combined with supply modulation to achieve high efficiency, high linearity, and flexible pulse-shaping capability in a single device.

the efficiency of a pulsed radar transmitter can be significantly improved by digitally modulating the power supply voltage to the main amplifier, while the envelope shaping of the pulse waveform can be implemented with a digital power DAC.

the combination of supply modulation, digital predistortion and pulse envelope shaping is an attractive approach for achieving high efficiency and spectral purity in pulsed radar transmitters, with the added benefit of flexibility in pulse shape.
